text: You say: "a fresh BOS inside it is a rally." Nothing new for my method: I already cut to 3 on that same fact, a recovery under the 200-day, so C5(a) is only partly met. But my test of rally versus trend is the pivotal point (C17, C19): BULLISH_BOS means the close cleared a confirmed pivot high, which is where I reclassify a Natural Rally as an Upward Trend resuming. rs_rank_pct is not on my menu, so I don't argue it. mp STRONG/ACCELERATING and KDP breaking alongside (C14) hold me. HOLD SUPPORT at 3. One observable turns me: a close back under the broken pivot or ma_200, or KDP failing with it.
